why: No major reviewer answers this exact question in one page, but several answer it in part with real testing: Good Housekeeping's tested roundup names 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 picks at $120, WIRED's tested roundup lists the $100 ESR CryoBoost as fastest, and Macworld has lab-tested single reviews of three in-budget Qi2.2 25W 3-in-1 stands (ESR, Kuxiu, Satechi). The rest is ESR store pages, deal posts, an AI aggregator table and affiliate listicles. A focused under-$120 comparison with current prices and tested codes could get in, but it would compete with tested major-reviewer pages rather than stand alone.
